title: API 580 Training in Tulsa, OK: RBI Exam Prep Online
description: Self-paced API 580 exam prep for Tulsa RBI planners and inspectors: Oklahoma refinery programmes, PSM mechanical integrity and RP 580, with instructor Q&A.
h1: API 580 Training in Tulsa: Risk-Based Inspection Exam Prep for Refinery Planners, Inspectors and Integrity Engineers
html:
API 580 exam prep for risk-based inspection work in and around Tulsa

API 580 is a different kind of examination from the inspector codes. It does not ask you to calculate a shell thickness or read a flange rating; it asks whether you understand how a risk-based inspection programme is set up, run and documented, and how probability and consequence of failure combine into a plan. According to API's programme page, the exam has 90 questions, of which 80 are scored and 10 are unscored pretest items, runs for three and a quarter hours and is closed book. The same page says it can be scheduled either at an in-person test centre or through remote proctoring. API's Body of Knowledge for the 2026 exams is based on the fourth edition of RP 580, published in 2023, with its first addendum of 2025.

There is no Atlantis classroom in Tulsa, and none is needed for this course: it is studied online at your own pace, with an instructor who answers questions when the reading raises them. API sets the eligibility rules, administers the API 580 examination and issues the certification. Atlantis has no API approval as a training provider, and the course prepares you for the exam rather than certifying you.

Who sits API 580 in Tulsa

  • Certified inspectors. Holders of a current API 510, API 570 or API 653 certification qualify for API 580 automatically. For an inspector at HF Sinclair's Tulsa refinery or a contract company serving it, API 580 is the logical next step once the plan they inspect against starts to come from an RBI study.
  • Inspection planners and coordinators. The people who turn RBI output into inspection tasks, due dates and turnaround scopes need to know where those dates come from and what makes them change.
  • Corrosion, materials and reliability engineers. Damage mechanism reviews and probability-of-failure assumptions are their work, and the exam's damage mechanism and data collection areas follow it closely.
  • Integrity staff from the midstream side. ONEOK has its headquarters in Tulsa, and pipeline integrity programmes use the language of risk too. API 580 is written for fixed equipment, though, so confirm with API how your experience will be treated.

If you do not hold one of the three inspector certifications, eligibility combines education with petrochemical industry experience gained in the last ten years: one year with a bachelor's degree in engineering or technology, two with a two-year degree or certificate, three with a high school diploma and five or more without formal education. API's page says any petrochemical industry experience counts, provided it is documented on the application.

Where RBI is chosen, required or restricted around Tulsa

RBI is a method that works inside the rules that apply to each kind of equipment, not above them. Around Tulsa, four different sets of rules shape what an RBI programme is allowed to do.

EquipmentRule that appliesWhat RBI can change
Vessels and piping in a PSM-covered refinery processOSHA's process safety management standard, 29 CFR 1910.119(j); Oklahoma's private-sector employers come under federal OSHAInspection frequency, provided it stays consistent with good engineering practice and is documented
Pressure vessels under Oklahoma's Boiler and Pressure Vessel Safety ActSection 141.13 of Title 40, which takes vessels within API 510's scope out of its three-year internal inspection rule and allows owner-user inspection under the API codeThe internal interval, through API 510's own RBI provisions, within an owner-user programme the state accepts
Pipeline breakout tanks, which relieve surges or hold liquid for reinjection into a pipeline49 CFR 195.432(b), which requires API 653 but not its risk-based alternative internal intervalWhere effort goes within the fixed intervals, not the internal interval itself
Fuel terminal tanks outside a pipeline systemOklahoma Corporation Commission rules in OAC 165:26, which cover tanks of gasoline, diesel, kerosene, aviation fuel and the other products they list (crude oil is not on the list) and adopt API 653 by reference; EPA's spill prevention rule for these and for crude tanksThe internal interval through API 653's risk-based option, within that standard's conditions

The mechanical integrity paragraph of the PSM standard applies to pressure vessels and storage tanks, piping systems, relief and vent systems, emergency shutdown systems, controls and pumps. It requires inspection and testing to follow recognized and generally accepted good engineering practices, at a frequency consistent with manufacturers' recommendations and good engineering practice and more often if operating experience shows the need, with each inspection documented. Nothing in it names RBI, which is why an RBI programme at an Oklahoma refinery has to show, in writing, how its intervals meet that test. On breakout tanks, PHMSA published a proposal in June 2026 that would allow RBI to set internal intervals, with ceilings of 20 years for the first internal inspection and 25 years after that; it is a proposed rule, not a final one, so the current federal text still governs.

RBI on a refinery that used to be two

HF Sinclair's Tulsa refinery began as two separate plants, bought from Sunoco and Sinclair in 2009 by Holly Corporation, a predecessor of HF Sinclair, and Holly's plan that year was to join them with interconnect pipelines carrying intermediate streams between the two. An RBI model for a site like that has to answer questions a single-owner plant never faces. Corrosion loops may now cross from one plant to the other, inventory groups depend on how the interconnects are isolated, and equipment records began under two different owners with their own habits of recording thickness data and repairs.

The crude slate is another live input. HF Sinclair says the refinery runs mainly sweet crude with up to 10,000 barrels per day of sour Canadian crude, and a shift in that proportion is the kind of process change that RP 580 treats as a reason to reassess, because sulfur and acid content drive several of the damage mechanisms in the model. The west plant's base oil, wax and solvent units bring flammable solvents and cold service into the consequence and damage mechanism reviews. Both plants sit within the city, so people and property close to a unit weigh heavily on the consequence side of the matrix.

Other Oklahoma programmes a Tulsa planner may support

Contract planners and engineers based in Tulsa often work on programmes elsewhere in the state. EIA's 2026 survey gives Phillips 66's Ponca City refinery 35 million cubic feet a day of hydrogen production capacity alongside its coker and cat cracker, and Valero's Ardmore refinery 27 million cubic feet a day with a distillate hydrocracker of 14,000 barrels per stream day. Hydrogen service at those levels puts high-temperature hydrogen attack and H2/H2S corrosion screening at the centre of the damage mechanism review. CVR's Wynnewood refinery, with its reformer and aromatics production, presents a different mix again. The same RP 580 framework applies to all three; what changes is which mechanisms dominate the probability side and which consequences dominate the other.

A closed-book scenario: what to do when the baseline is missing

A typical API 580 question gives you an awkward data problem rather than a number to calculate. Try this one.

An RBI team is assessing an exchanger shell that came to the site with no record of its original thickness. One thickness survey exists, taken eight years ago. Which approach fits the principles of RP 580?

  1. Use the nominal thickness on the drawing as the baseline and calculate a corrosion rate from it.
  2. Record the gap, assign a conservative corrosion assumption until better data exist, and plan an inspection designed to reduce the uncertainty.
  3. Leave the shell out of the assessment until the original records are found.
  4. Set its probability of failure from the age of the unit alone.

The answer is the second. RP 580 expects the team to deal with missing or poor data openly, usually through conservative assumptions that are written down, and it treats inspection's main contribution to risk as a reduction in uncertainty about the equipment's condition. Using nominal thickness invents a baseline that may never have existed and can produce a corrosion rate that is badly wrong in either direction. Excluding the shell leaves risk unassessed, and age alone ignores everything the damage mechanism review has to say.

Studying RP 580 for a closed-book paper

The 2026 Body of Knowledge organises the exam into ten areas: terms, definitions and acronyms; risk assessment; the RBI programme; roles, responsibilities, training and qualifications; data collection; damage mechanisms; probability of failure; consequence of failure; risk management; and RBI documentation. Because no reference is allowed in the room, the method is different from the inspector exams. Read RP 580 through once for its argument, then again area by area, and learn the defined terms precisely, since many questions turn on the difference between two similar words. Practise scenario questions that make you choose between plausible actions, and send the instructor any question where two answers both seem right. Planners who work Tulsa turnarounds can treat the outage itself as revision: every scope change, deferred task and new finding is a live example of risk being re-ranked.

If you choose remote proctoring, read API's current requirements for the room and the computer well before the day; if you prefer a test centre, Prometric lists centres in and around Tulsa. Atlantis's explainer on API 580 and API 581 clarifies which document does what.

When a Tulsa site needs an RBI study rather than a course

Exam preparation gives an individual the vocabulary and judgement to take part in an RBI programme; it does not produce the programme. A site that needs one built or revalidated is looking at engineering work on its own equipment data, and Atlantis carries out remote RBI studies of that kind as a separate service. In either case the owner's inspection organisation stays in charge of approving intervals.

Sponsoring API 580 candidates from a Tulsa organisation

An employer can sponsor a single planner or a whole integrity group, and fees are quoted on request. A sensible order is to put the inspectors and planners who will use the RBI output through first, so that a programme is understood by the people who carry it out, and then the engineers who run the reviews. Each candidate applies to API in their own name and studies at their own pace, so nobody has to leave the site for class days.

faq.q: Do I need API 510 or API 570 before I can sit API 580?
faq.a: No. Holding a current API 510, API 570 or API 653 certification qualifies you for API 580 automatically, which saves documenting your experience again. Without one of them, you qualify through education and petrochemical industry experience from the last ten years: one year with an engineering or technology bachelor's degree, two with a two-year degree or certificate, three with a high school diploma, or five or more with no formal education.

faq.q: Can I take the API 580 exam from home in Tulsa?
faq.a: API's programme page says the API 580 exam can be scheduled either at an in-person test centre or through remote proctoring, which makes it unlike API 510, 570 and 653. If you take it remotely, check API's current rules for the room, the computer and identification well in advance. If you would rather sit it at a test centre, Prometric lists centres in and around Tulsa.

faq.q: Does OSHA require RBI at Oklahoma refineries?
faq.a: No. Private-sector employers in Oklahoma come under federal OSHA, and its process safety management standard requires inspection and testing that follows recognized and generally accepted good engineering practices, at documented frequencies. RBI is one way to set and justify those frequencies, and API 510 and API 570 provide for it, but the standard does not require any particular method.

faq.q: Does Oklahoma's boiler and pressure vessel law allow RBI intervals?
faq.a: The Act does not mention RBI by name. Section 141.13 of Title 40 excludes vessels within the scope of the API Pressure Vessel Inspection Code from its three-year internal inspection requirement and allows owner-user inspection under the API code, and the Labor Commissioner may set longer intervals by rule and allow variations based on documented operating conditions. An owner using RBI under API 510 should confirm how its programme fits the state's requirements.

faq.q: I work in pipeline integrity for a Tulsa midstream company. Does my experience count for API 580?
faq.a: It may. API's page says any petrochemical industry experience counts for API 580, which is broader wording than the inspector exams use, but the exam itself concerns RBI for fixed equipment under RP 580 rather than pipeline integrity management. Describe your duties clearly on the application, and ask API if you are unsure how they will be judged. Many of the risk concepts will be familiar from pipeline work.

faq.q: Which edition of RP 580 should I study?
faq.a: API's 2026 Body of Knowledge is based on the fourth edition of RP 580, published in 2023, together with its first addendum, issued in 2025, and it says the exam focuses on the most recent edition. Before you start, check the Body of Knowledge and effectivity information for the window you are aiming at, because API updates them for each exam year.

faq.q: Will passing API 580 let me approve inspection intervals at my plant?
faq.a: Not by itself. API 580 certification shows that you understand RBI principles and RP 580. Who approves an interval is set by the inspection code that applies, by the owner's procedures and, for regulated equipment, by the rules that govern it. Many API 580 holders work in teams where an API 510, 570 or 653 inspector or the owner's inspection supervisor signs off the plan.

faq.q: How do I keep API 580 once I have it?
faq.a: API 580 runs for a three-year term. You can apply to recertify from 90 days before it expires, there is a 90-day grace period with late fees, and API says employment verification is not currently required to recertify. If you miss the grace period, the certification expires and you would need to apply again and pass the full examination.
